examples.solution_text:
Add all three boundary sides.
$\begin{align*}P&=13+11+7\\&=31\text{ cm}\end{align*}$

(a) All four sides are $8\text{ cm}$, so use multiplication for repeated addition.
$\begin{align*}P&=4\times8\\&=32\text{ cm}\end{align*}$

(b) Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$\begin{align*}P&=13+6+13+6\\&=2\times(13+6)\\&=38\text{ m}\end{align*}$
